name: pilot-v1
note: Local pilot for EVAL-03. A stand-in fixture, not the team's frozen benchmark. Every other pinned setting (engine, BAR commit, start positions, end rule, debug commands) is in each run folder's run_settings.json.
repeat_meaning: Games differ run to run even with the engine's fixed seed, so a repeat is one more independent game. For a sampled policy the repeat number is also its sampling seed.
